title: CMDDR Document
description: One concrete magisterial document / speech. References a Genre. May be fully described by its Genre alone (no Assessments) or carry one Assessment per notable passage.

id.description: Canonical identifier: 'mag:{issuer}/{incipit-slug}-{year}', or 'mag:{issuer}/{series-id}-{occasion-year}' when series is set. The issuer segment is the local part of issuerId. The exact form is fixed by idStatus below. See the identifiers spec §3 and the messages spec §3.

genre.description: Foreign key -> genre.id in data/genres.json. Null when the source genre has no Genre Registry row yet; sourceGenreLabel then records the raw label.

issuerId.description: Prefixed registry id of the concrete issuer, e.g. 'rp:john-paul-ii', 'oec:vatican-ii'.

issuerType.description: Role/capacity of the issuer. Drives the computed-infallibility rule; must be one of the genre's issuerTypes.

promulgatedBy.description: Optional prefixed id of the pope who promulgated the document, when distinct from the issuer. Does not change issuerType.

incipit.description: The incipit as printed by the source, unnormalised (e.g. 'Adiutricem populi').

incipitLang.description: ISO 639-1 language of the incipit; vernacular incipits are first-class.

idStatus.description: 'minted' ids are permanent; 'provisional' ids may be re-minted.

sigla.description: Conventional scholarly abbreviation (EV, LG, GS). Display only, never a key.

sourceGenreLabel.description: Genre label exactly as the source prints it (e.g. 'Enciclica', 'Protesta').

alsoShelvedAs.description: Other vatican.va shelves the same document is filed under; the shelves are not disjoint.

scope.description: Overrides genre.defaultScope. Juridical reach of the act (whom it binds), not its addressee; for an apostolic-letter, whose genre spans universal teaching and local governance, expected to be set per document rather than inherited.

characteristics.description: Non-exclusive document-level metadata; each entry must be among the genre's allowedCharacteristics in data/genres.json. 'dogmatic-definition' asserts the document contains an ex cathedra definition and must be backed by a Table 2 assessment with register=extraordinary and intent=definitive. 'motu-proprio' records a mode of issuance (on the pope's own initiative), not a genre, and makes no authority claim.

keywords.description: Descriptive subject tags -> keyword.id in data/keywords.json. Never authority-bearing: unlike characteristics, a keyword makes no claim about the document's register or definitiveness, and no invariant other than vocabulary membership reads it.

actKind.description: What kind of act the document is. Absent means 'teaching'. 'governance' is a juridical act (erecting a diocese, proclaiming a patron, approving statutes); 'liturgical' is a rite or blessing (an Urbi et Orbi). The operative act is then not a statement Table 2 assesses and the genre's default register does not describe it; a passage that does teach (the address before an Urbi et Orbi blessing) is still assessed per statement, so the flag never forbids an Assessment. Never authority-bearing: like keywords, it makes no claim about register or definitiveness, and no invariant reads it.

id.description: Foreign key -> series.id in data/series.json: the occasion the series belongs to (e.g. 'world-day-of-peace'). It is the slug segment of the document's id.

year.description: The year of the occasion as the title prints it ('LVIII Giornata Mondiale della Pace 2025' -> 2025), which is the year segment of the document's id. Distinct from the year of date: the 2025 Peace message is signed 8 December 2024. Never derived from date; where the title prints none, a curated row supplies it.

ordinal.description: The document's number within the series, as the source prints it (the 'LI' of 'LI Giornata Mondiale della Pace', the '110' of '110ª Giornata Mondiale del Migrante'). Omit wherever the source prints none, whether the series is dated rather than numbered (the Lent messages) or a single title inside a numbered series lacks one. Never computed from the vocabulary row's firstYear; invariant 24 checks the two against each other where both are present.

series.description: Membership in a numbered or dated annual series (World Day of Peace, World Communications Day, Lent message...). A document with series set takes the series-form id 'mag:{issuer}/{series-id}-{year}' and is minted without needing an incipit. Otherwise discovery metadata only, with no bearing on register, ceiling or assent; invariants 23 (vocabulary membership), 10, 12 (id round-trip) and 24 (ordinal against firstYear) read it.
The gazette: the Acta Apostolicae Sedis (1909-) or the Acta Sanctae Sedis (1865-1908).

volume.description: The volume number as the index prints it (Vol. CXV -> 115); for the AAS it is year - 1908, but it is read, never computed.

year.description: The volume year, which can differ from date: a December act is published in the next year's volume.

page.description: The first page of the act, as the index cites it. No range: the conventional short citation is 'AAS 87 (1995) 401'.

part.description: Reserved for the two-part volumes of 1917 and 1983; not used in phase 1.

acta.description: Where the act stands in the Acta Apostolicae Sedis (or Acta Sanctae Sedis): the citation of record, 'AAS 115 (2023) 1041' being { series: 'AAS', volume: 115, year: 2023, page: 1041 }. A reference joined to the shelf harvest, not a substitute for it: written by the harvest for the documents an annual AAS index entry matches by issuer, date and incipit (2015-2024 in phase 1). Purely bibliographic and never authority-bearing, like keywords, series and actKind; the only invariant is 25, uniqueness of (series, volume, page), since one page opens one act. See #25.

descriptiveTitle.description: Optional descriptive title of a conciliar Constitution (mutually exclusive; omit for a plain constitution such as Sacrosanctum Concilium). Descriptive of purpose only — NOT a claim of authority, and unlike 'dogmatic-definition' it is not backed by any assessment.

aliases.description: Alternative titles (e.g. 'The Gospel of Life'). Incipits live in the incipit field.

allOf.description: a minted id requires an incipit or a series (a series-form id is keyed by occasion, not by first words); a null genre requires the raw source label
a series-form id is minted by rule (messages spec §3.2.2): a document with series set is never provisional
a minted id is issuer/incipit-slug-year (or issuer/series-id-year), optionally extended to the full date to resolve an incipit collision
a provisional id is issuer/genre-slug-YYYY-MM-DD with an optional ordinal
